description: Facebook only: like comments on the Page's own posts as the Page. Pass nice: true to like every comment comments_nice lists, or comment_ids (with account_id) for chosen ones from comments_recent or comments_nice. A comment already liked here is skipped, so calling again is safe, and a liked comment leaves comments_nice. Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky and Mastodon have no way to like a comment, so those calls are refused. Likes can't be taken back from here.

account_id.description: Required with comment_ids; with nice: true only this account's

comment_ids.description: Comments to like, on the one account_id

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

nice.description: true: like every current nice comment (comments_nice)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: comment_like
title: Like comments
